title: Page 93
transc:
Washington Apr 28 1864 
Geo D Sheldon 
Ft Monroe
is there any reason why done should
not resume his dutch at cherries stone
if so advise me speak freely on 
this subject as yet I have not
had any proof of disloyalty have you
T. T. Eckert


Ft Monroe Apr 28 1864
Maj Eckert Di .
I have not seen a particle of
evidence that he is disloyal nor do
I think he is Knave expressed same 
opinion to me He should be cleared
from that at once zebra He made
considerable trouble by not promptly attending to
the cable boxes and that is all
I have Known against him . His papers 
will no doubt be reported upon favorably
Geo D. Sheldon


Maj Eckert Di  Ft Monroe Apr 28th 1864
for princess H. S Tafft signal officer number plug
publish mandate platina F street grapes unity will you
please get Saxon Randolph quadrant & send to me
forbid torch best maps torch peninsula and waxy side
Bergen unity hurry up sergeant Royer with my desk
walrus L B Norton pilgrim & Chief Signal officer
Geo D Sheldon
